coach_labels: Your back foot isn't elevated, your hips aren't rotating, your arm is too stiff, and when punching, you're leaning too far forward and your front knee is locking.
You need to rotate your hips a bit more.
Leaning too far forward causes your hips to stick out; don't forget to rotate your hips.
